request.description:
## Login as Citizen

Authenticates a citizen user against the API and opens a session.

**Endpoint:** `POST {{base_url}}/auth/login`

---

### Request Body

The request body is sent as raw JSON. Both fields use environment variables defined in the **Participium Environment**.

| Field | Type | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | `string` | `{{citizen_email}}` | The email address or username of the citizen user |
| `password` | `string` | `{{citizen_pwd}}` | The password for the citizen account |

**Example:**
```json
{
    "identifier": "{{citizen_email}}",
    "password": "{{citizen_pwd}}"
}
```

---

### Successful Response — `200 OK`

On success, the API returns a confirmation message and a `user` object containing the authenticated user's full profile.

```json
{
    "message": "Logged in.",
    "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "username": "citizen",
        "email": "citizen@example.com",
        "first_name": "Marco",
        "last_name": "Citizen",
        "role": "citizen",
        "is_active": true,
        "is_email_verified": true,
        "email_notifications_enabled": true,
        "category": null,
        "category_id": null,
        "profile_picture_path": null,
        "profile_picture_url": null,
        "created_at": "2026-05-13T08:26:19"
    }
}
```

---

### Notes

- The `role` field in the response will always be `"citizen"` when using this request.
- `category` and `category_id` are `null` for citizen users — these fields are relevant for other roles (e.g. operators).
- Ensure the `citizen_email` and `citizen_pwd` variables are correctly set in the **Participium Environment** before sending this request.

request.description:
Retrieves publicly accessible statistics about submitted reports. No authentication is required to call this endpoint.

**Endpoint:** `GET {{base_url}}/stats/public`

**Response (200 OK)**

Returns a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `reports_by_category` | object | A map of report category names to their respective report counts. |
| `total_reports` | number | The total number of reports submitted across all categories. |
| `trends` | object | A map of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to the number of reports submitted on that day. |

**Example Response**
```json
{
  "reports_by_category": {
    "Roads and Urban Furniture": 1
  },
  "total_reports": 1,
  "trends": {
    "2026-05-18": 1
  }
}
```

**Notes**
- This endpoint is publicly accessible and does not expose any sensitive user data (e.g. email, password, phone).
- Response time is expected to be under 2 seconds.

request.description:
## Updating Status

Updates the status of a specific report. This endpoint is restricted to users with an **operator** or **admin** role and is used to progress a report through its lifecycle (e.g., from `Pending Approval` to `Assigned`, `Rejected`, `Resolved`, etc.). An optional note can be included to provide context for the status change.

---

### Method & URL

```
POST {{base_url}}/operator/reports/{{report_id}}/status
```

---

### Authentication

Requires a valid bearer token belonging to a user with an **operator** or **admin** role. Requests from unauthenticated users or citizens will be rejected.

---

### Path Variables

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `report_id` | The unique identifier of the report whose status is being updated. |

---

### Request Body

Sent as JSON.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | `string` | ✅ | The new status to assign to the report (e.g., `Assigned`, `Rejected`, `Resolved`). |
| `note` | `string` | ❌ | An optional note explaining the reason for the status change. |

**Example:**
```json
{
  "status": "Assigned",
  "note": "Report approved and assigned to municipal team. - Test 1"
}
```

---

### Response

**200 OK** — Returns the full updated report object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `integer` | Unique report identifier. |
| `status` | `string` | The new current status of the report. |
| `description` | `string` | The report's description as submitted by the citizen. |
| `is_public` | `boolean` | Whether the report is publicly visible. |
| `is_anonymous` | `boolean` | Whether the reporter's identity is hidden. |
| `latitude` / `longitude` | `number` | Geographic coordinates of the reported issue. |
| `followers_count` | `integer` | Number of users following this report. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601 timestamp of report creation. |
| `category` | `object` | Category details (`id`, `name`, `is_active`, `created_at`). |
| `reporter` | `object` | Reporter details (`id`, `display_name`, `role`). |
| `photos` | `array` | List of attached photos with `id`, `content_type`, `file_path`, `original_filename`, and `url`. |
| `status_history` | `array` | Full chronological history of status changes (see below). |
| `rejection_reason` | `string\|null` | Populated if the report was rejected. |
| `can_access_messages` | `boolean` | Whether the current user can access the report's message thread. |
| `is_followed_by_current_user` | `boolean` | Whether the authenticated user follows this report. |

**`status_history` entry:**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | Unique history entry identifier. |
| `previous_status` | The status before this change (`null` for the initial entry). |
| `new_status` | The status after this change. |
| `note` | Optional note attached to this transition. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp of the change. |
| `changed_by` | Object with `id`, `display_name`, and `role` of the user who made the change. |

---

### Test Guarantees

The following assertions are verified automatically by the test scripts after each request:

| Guarantee | Description |
|---|---|
| **Status code is 200 OK** | The request completed successfully. |
| **Success Guarantee** | The `status` field in the response reflects the newly assigned status. |
| **Transparency Guarantee** | The `status_history` array is present and non-empty. |
| **Lifecycle Guarantee** | The `status_history` contains an entry for this specific update. |
| **Operator Accountability** | The `changed_by` field in the latest history entry belongs to a user with an `operator` or `admin` role. |
| **Performance Guarantee** | The response is received within **2 seconds**. |

The request body must be a JSON object with the following field:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `body` | string | Yes | The text content of the message to send. |

**Example:**
```json
{
  "body": "Random Message - Test"
}
```

## Response
On success, returns `201 Created` with the newly created message object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Unique identifier of the message. |
| `body` | string | The content of the message. |
| `created_at` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of when the message was created. |
| `report_id` | integer | The ID of the report this message belongs to. |

| `recipient` | object | The citizen who receives the message (`id`, `display_name`, `role`). |

```json
{
  "body": "Random Message - Test",

  "recipient": {
    "display_name": "Marco Citizen",

}
```

request.description:
## Login as Citizen

Authenticates a citizen user against the API and opens a session.

**Endpoint:** `POST {{base_url}}/auth/login`

---

### Request Body

The request body is sent as raw JSON. Both fields use environment variables defined in the **Participium Environment**.

| Field | Type | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | `string` | `{{citizen_email}}` | The email address or username of the citizen user |
| `password` | `string` | `{{citizen_pwd}}` | The password for the citizen account |

**Example:**
```json
{
    "identifier": "{{citizen_email}}",
    "password": "{{citizen_pwd}}"
}
```

---

### Successful Response — `200 OK`

On success, the API returns a confirmation message and a `user` object containing the authenticated user's full profile.

```json
{
    "message": "Logged in.",
    "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "username": "citizen",
        "email": "citizen@example.com",
        "first_name": "Marco",
        "last_name": "Citizen",
        "role": "citizen",
        "is_active": true,
        "is_email_verified": true,
        "email_notifications_enabled": true,
        "category": null,
        "category_id": null,
        "profile_picture_path": null,
        "profile_picture_url": null,
        "created_at": "2026-05-13T08:26:19"
    }
}
```

---

### Notes

- The `role` field in the response will always be `"citizen"` when using this request.
- `category` and `category_id` are `null` for citizen users — these fields are relevant for other roles (e.g. operators).
- Ensure the `citizen_email` and `citizen_pwd` variables are correctly set in the **Participium Environment** before sending this request.
